xccdf-1.2:Profile.xccdf-1.2:title: DISA STIG for RHEL 9, tailored for the calc hardened container image
xccdf-1.2:Profile.xccdf-1.2:description: (1) var_system_crypto_policy: FIPS:STIG -> FIPS. The UBI 9 crypto-policies package does not ship the STIG sub-policy module, so FIPS:STIG cannot be set in a UBI image. FIPS is the policy required by RHEL-09-215100 and restricts OpenSSL to the FIPS 140-3 validated provider. (2) network_configure_name_resolution: deselected. /etc/resolv.conf is injected by the container runtime at start, not part of the image. security_patches_up_to_date stays in the profile; it is reported as notchecked offline and is covered by "dnf upgrade" at build time and the Trivy CVE gate.
